title: Recent US government capital driving America's graphite projects
gist: US federal agencies, including the US Army and EXIM, provided funding or land in August and September for graphite anode projects that struggled to attract private capital, including a USD $25 million EXIM loan for Westwater's Alabama plant. Benchmark's Tony Alderson argues loans, land, grants and tariffs are narrowing the cost gap with Chinese material.
